name: The Collector
description: Archivist Solen is fascinated by your relay log. He wants you to find Survey Marker Delta-7 at the Old Survey Point beyond the perimeter ravine.

find_marker.label: Find Survey Marker Delta-7
find_marker.description: Travel through the deep perimeter east and the ravine to find the Old Survey Point where Survey Marker Delta-7 was installed.

return_to_solen.label: Return to Archivist Solen
return_to_solen.description: Bring the Survey Marker back to Archivist Solen in the Meridian Archives.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Collector. Archivist Solen rewards you with the Resonance Detector.
